The review found one serious bug and I fixed it. Two minor findings are waiting for your decision. Nothing is committed.

**Fixed: amounts lost a digit when the cents part was below ten.**
- **What went wrong:** `cents 5` printed `$0.5` instead of `$0.05`. A euro amount would print `EUR2.5` instead of the `EUR2.50` your README shows.
- **The fix:** one line in `src/format.js`, `String(cents % 100).padStart(2, '0')`, which adds the missing zero.
- **Proof:**
  - Your feature check `two-decimal-places` failed before the fix and passes now.
  - I added a new test, `test/padding.test.js`. It fails on your old code and passes on the fixed code.
  - The reviewer said your existing test also failed. That was wrong: it only uses `1999` and `1050`, so it passed before and after.

**Left for you (both minor, neither fixed):**
- **F-2** `bin/cents.js:23`: if `--symbol` has no value after it, the tool silently uses `$`. `cents --symbol 250` reads `250` as the symbol and then says the amount is missing.
- **F-3**: your existing test doesn't check the new symbol parameter. The new `test/padding.test.js` does check `formatCents(250, 'EUR')`, so this one may already be covered.

**Not done:**
- I didn't commit, because commits aren't delegated in this repo and F-2 and F-3 still need your decision.
- The commit gate (a check that stops commits until a review passes) isn't set up in this repo. I left it that way.
- Before you commit, `test/padding.test.js` and your three changed files are all uncommitted.

**Your change had two bugs, and both are fixed. The tests now pass (3 of 3). I did not commit anything.**

**What was wrong**
- **Trailing hyphens were no longer removed.** Your edit to `src/slug.js` dropped the trailing part of the trim (`/^-+|-+$/g` became `/^-+/`). So `slugify('Hello, World!')` returned `'hello-world-'`, and your existing tests failed.
- **`maxLength` could leave a hyphen at the end.** If the cut fell right after a hyphen, it stayed: `slugify('Release notes for March', { maxLength: 14 })` returned `'release-notes-'`.

**The fix:** one line in `src/slug.js`, which fixes both bugs. It removes trailing hyphens after the cut:
```js
    .slice(0, maxLength)
    .replace(/-+$/, '');
```
I also added `test/slug-maxlength.test.js`, which tests the `maxLength` example above. It passes on the fixed code. I couldn't show that this test alone would have caught the bug, because the old code already failed your existing tests. I kept the test anyway.

**Waiting for you**
- **F-4 (low severity):** the reviewer noted there was no test for `maxLength`. The new test file covers that case, so you can probably close it.
- **Commit:** nothing is staged or committed. When you're back, check the new test file, then run `git add -A` and commit. I didn't set up the optional commit gate, which would block my commits until a review passes; it can wait until you're back.
